name: Studio
summary: Cut a long screen recording into a short video in your own voice — AI proposes the scenes and cuts, you tune them, nothing is re-voiced.

manualSteps.title: Connect Replicate
manualSteps.body: Add your Replicate API token under Settings → AI → Replicate. Powers transcription (WhisperX), scene direction + refiner (Gemini), voice clone/speech (MiniMax — cloning ≈ $3/call), and thumbnails.

manualSteps.title: Connect Anthropic
manualSteps.body: Add an Anthropic API key under Settings → AI → LLM Providers → Add Provider. It powers thumbnail prompt drafts (Claude Sonnet) and the companion blog writer (Claude Opus).

manualSteps.title: Turn on cross-origin isolation
manualSteps.body: Settings → Response Headers → Add Rule → click the Cross-Origin Isolation preset → Create. Studio's in-browser video export needs it; without it, export falls back to a slower single-threaded encoder.

manualSteps.title: Keep Studio private
manualSteps.body: Studio's API rules carry no per-rule auth — access control is the only protection for the paid AI endpoints. Under Settings → General → Visibility, set it to Private, then optionally set Required Role to Admin or higher.

manualSteps.title: Optional: HF_TOKEN for speaker diarization
manualSteps.body: Optional — transcription works without it. Only for speaker diarization. Create a secret named HF_TOKEN (a Hugging Face read token) under Settings → AI → Secrets, and accept the gated model's terms on Hugging Face.
